title: The ALMA REBELS Survey: dust continuum detections at z > 6.5
question: To present dust continuum detections and flux extractions of 49 UV-selected luminous galaxies at z > 6.5 from the ALMA REBELS survey and its pilot programs, and investigate their IR luminosities, obscured star formation fractions, and spatial offsets between rest-UV and far-IR emission.

what.value: Literature continuum flux measurements and upper limits for pilot and overlapping targets
UV spectral slope (beta_UV) and molecular index (I_m) values for dust-detected sources

evidence.quote: Measured offset between the UV and dust peak emission, listed together with $\beta_{\rm UV}$ (cite: Bouw21b) and $I_m$ (cite: Ferr22).

what.value: Median dust temperature (T_d = 46 K) and L_IR conversion factors from infrared SED models

evidence.quote: This is the median $T_{\rm d}$ of the REBELS sources with both dust and \[C ii\] detections, calculated based on the method proposed by (cite: Somm21)
The conversion factor was computed from the infrared SEDs predicted by (cite: Somm22).

recipe.goal: Create dust continuum images from calibrated datacubes
recipe.method: Image calibrated datacubes with TCLEAN and collapse to continuum maps by excluding channels within 2 x FWHM around any detected [C II] or [O III] emission line.
key_parameters: cell size = 0.15 arcsec, natural weighting, automasking threshold = 2 sigma, line exclusion = 2 x FWHM

recipe.goal: Identify dust continuum sources and determine purity threshold
recipe.method: Run PyBDSF on non-primary-beam-corrected science images (within r = 1.5 arcsec of phase centre) and negative (-1 x science) images (over full primary beam, scaled to r = 1.5 arcsec area) across a grid of iSNR and pSNR to select thresholds giving 95% purity.
key_parameters: pSNR = 3.3, iSNR = 2.0, search radius = 1.5 arcsec, minimum island size = 1/3 of beam area pixels

recipe.goal: Measure dust continuum flux densities and upper limits
recipe.method: Fit 2D Gaussian components using CASA imfit in a 3x3 arcsec box around PyBDSF positions; test whether sources are resolved via Monte Carlo point-source injection simulations; adopt integrated flux for resolved sources (REBELS-25) and peak flux for unresolved sources; compute 3 sigma upper limits for non-detections from dirty image RMS multiplied by 3 and by a 1.33 flux boosting factor.
key_parameters: Fitting region = 3 x 3 arcsec (1.5 x 1.8 arcsec for REBELS-40); 20,000 mock point sources (100 simulations per image x 5 sources); flux boosting factor = 1.33 at S/N = 3

recipe.goal: Apply CMB correction and calculate total infrared luminosities (L_IR) and SFRs
recipe.method: Correct continuum fluxes for the CMB effect (~4-18%), then convert rest-frame 158 um or 88 um monochromatic luminosity to total L_IR (8-1000 um) using median conversion factors from Sommovigo et al. (2022), and compute SFR_UV and SFR_IR.
key_parameters: L_IR = 14 (+8/-5) nu L_nu,158um; L_IR = 8 (+1/-4) nu L_nu,88um; SFR_UV = 7.1e-29 L_nu; SFR_IR = 1.2e-10 L_IR
assumptions: Flat LambdaCDM cosmology with H = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_M = 0.3, Omega_Lambda = 0.7; Chabrier (2003) IMF
Single-temperature modified blackbody dust SED with dust emissivity spectral index beta = 2.0 and median dust temperature T_d = 46 K

recipe.goal: Derive rest-UV and optical galaxy properties via SED fitting
recipe.method: Fit rest-UV/optical/NIR photometry using the BEAGLE code (excluding ALMA dust continuum measurements) to derive M_UV, beta_UV, A_V, stellar mass, stellar age, and [O III]+Hbeta EW; compare dust-detected and undetected distributions with two-sample KS tests.
assumptions: Constant star formation history, sub-solar metallicity, Chabrier (2003) IMF, Calzetti et al. (2000) dust extinction curve

recipe.goal: Align NIR astrometry and measure spatial offsets between rest-UV and dust emission peaks
recipe.method: Align NIR/HST images to Gaia DR3 using 3-sigma-clipped mean separations of crossmatched stars (corrected for proper motion and excluding parallax > 10 mas); fit 2D Gaussians to rest-UV (JHK-stacked) and dust continuum images to find emission peaks and compute angular and physical spatial separations; test correlation with I_m using Spearman rank correlation.
key_parameters: Cropped image size = 6 x 6 arcmin for XMM fields; parallax cutoff <= 10 mas; 3-sigma clipping for mean Gaia offset; 2D Gaussian peak fit with xy width fixed to 1 pixel and background fixed to 0

answer_key.quantity: Number of dust continuum detections in REBELS and pilot programs

evidence.quote: We report 18 dust continuum detections ($\geq 3.3\sigma$) at $\sim88$$\mu$m and 158$\mu$m out of 49 ultraviolet(UV)-bright galaxies ($M_{\rm UV} < -21.3$ mag) at $z>6.5$

answer_key.quantity: Dust continuum detection rate in main REBELS survey

evidence.quote: In total we detected dust continuum emission with $\geq 3.3\sigma$ in 16 out of the 40 REBELS targets ($\geq 40\%$) in the central $r=1.5\ensuremath{''}$ of the images.

score_reason: The ALMA continuum imaging (TCLEAN, natural weighting, 0.15 arcsec cell, 2 sigma automasking), source detection (PyBDSF with pSNR=3.3, iSNR=2.0 in r=1.5 arcsec), flux extraction (CASA imfit in 3x3 arcsec box, peak vs integrated rules), and L_IR/SFR conversion formulas are clearly and quantitatively specified. Deductions are due to target coordinates, line-exclusion windows, and NIR imaging/SED details being deferred to companion papers.
rediscovery_reason: All six ALMA project codes are public in the archive, the continuum imaging and PyBDSF/imfit flux extraction workflow is well-defined and scriptable, and Table 1 provides a complete numeric answer key (frequencies, flux densities, SNRs, upper limits, and L_IR) for all 49 targets.
